about: Project Away's built-in model list. models/catalog.json in the repository adds or updates entries without an app update (see README > Models).

models.title: MediaPipe hands (built in)
models.description: Finds your hands and fingers in the camera picture.

models.title: MediaPipe face (built in)
models.description: Sees whether you face the screen and talk (attention and face gating).

models.title: Iris + head pose (built in)
models.description: Estimates where you look from your eyes; no extra download.

models.title: MobileGaze (small network)
models.description: A small learned gaze network; a little steadier than iris alone.

models.title: L2CS (best gaze)
models.description: The most accurate gaze network; best with a graphics card.

models.title: Whisper large-v3-turbo on the graphics card
models.description: The most accurate speech-to-text; fast on an NVIDIA card.

models.title: Whisper distil-large-v3 on the graphics card
models.description: Nearly as accurate, faster, uses less graphics memory (English).

models.title: Whisper small on the processor
models.description: Good accuracy without a graphics card.

models.title: Whisper base on the processor (lightest)
models.description: The lightest; fine for short commands.

models.title: Rules (built in)
models.description: Removes fillers and fixes punctuation instantly; no download.

models.title: Smart cleanup - Qwen 0.5B
models.description: A small local language model that polishes punctuation and tone.

models.title: Smart cleanup - Qwen 1.5B
models.description: Better wording than 0.5B; best with a graphics card.

models.title: Smart cleanup - Ollama (any model)
models.description: Uses a model you run in Ollama on this PC.

models.title: Natural (Kokoro)
models.description: A natural, human-sounding voice for your agents' messages.

models.title: Light (Piper)
models.description: A clear, light voice that starts speaking almost instantly.
models.license: voice data: Blizzard 2013 Lessac licence (see the Piper model card); engine code MIT

models.title: Best available
models.description: The most natural voice that is ready on this PC, then the next one.

models.title: Windows natural
models.description: The newer Windows voices (Windows 10/11); nothing to download.

models.title: Classic system voice
models.description: The old system voice (Windows David/Zira, macOS say, espeak).
